notes: Logo is a vector reconstruction (potrace, 1 colour #786f72) of the business's own 255x255 site header logo JPG, not a TM-supplied vector. The source was upscaled and converted to an area-preserving coverage mask before tracing so stroke weight matches the original; render-back mean abs diff 3.77 vs the original JPG (1.86 vs the prepared input).
The 1000x1000 blue-disc PNG on bookedevents.co.uk is the same mark, but its trace lost the tent's seam lines and thickened 'Event Hire', so the business's own site logo was used.
The grey mark has low contrast on dark backgrounds, so show it on a light tile.

Showreel: 6 clips from 5 public TikTok posts by @tmeventhire (downloaded without cookies). No usable clip came from Vimeo, because the business's site videos are Vimeo-hosted and Vimeo downloads were not allowed in this session.

All TikTok sources are portrait (576x1024 to 1080x1920), so the desktop 16:9 reel is a centre band upscaled from those frames and is softer than the phone reel; one clip (post 7429083756129946913) is 576p.
Gallery photos are the business's own uploads from tmeventhire.co.uk; the outdoor ceremony photo was left out because it shows children in the aisle.
